subject: Next steps: Procurement path & PR guidance (Coupa/Ariba) - Redwood / Acme
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: Procurement path & PR guidance (Coupa/Ariba) - Redwood / Acme

Hi Alex - thanks again for the call this morning, great to learn more about Acme's use cases and timeline. Quick recap and a few asks so we can get procurement moving on our side: 

- Primary commercial path: you mentioned purchases > $10k go via PO and the procurement team handles supplier onboarding in Coupa/Ariba.
- Marketplace: you asked if Redwood is available on marketplaces - we support AWS Marketplace and can discuss GCP/Azure listing if needed.
- Next steps for procurement: we need to confirm whether Acme will onboard Redwood as a supplier (Coupa/Ariba) or pay via P-card. Please confirm supplier onboarding owner and any supplier ID if you already have one for Redwood.

Attached: Redwood_Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf (we filled in high-level legal details; happy to add whatever procurement needs).

Proposed next steps:
1) Can procurement confirm vendor onboarding owner and timeline?
2) If PO path: please confirm required fields (supplier ID, remit-to address, W9) so we can expedite.
3) If P-card path preferred, who on your finance team handles P-card approvals?

I cc'd Aditya from Sales Ops and Neha from Customer Success to help with supplier forms, invoicing options, and to stay aligned on the commercial path.

Thanks - I can hop on a quick call with your procurement contact if that's helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Procurement path & PR guidance (Coupa/Ariba) - Redwood / Acme

Thanks for the recap, Marissa - that matches our conversation. A couple of clarifications from procurement side: 

- For amounts > $10k we require a PO and supplier onboarding in Coupa.
- Procurement will own creating the PR once the supplier is registered in our system. I have cc'd procurement@acmecorp.com to kick off onboarding.
- Can Redwood confirm accepted billing term (Net30), remit-to address, and provide a completed vendor form and W9? Also let us know if you can onboard to Coupa or Ariba directly, or if we should handle registration internally.

We do not typically use marketplace billing for enterprise contracts unless the vendor provides marketplace-managed billing. Please advise if AWS Marketplace is required on your side - otherwise PO is our preference. 

Alex
Alex Johnson
IT Procurement | Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acmecorp.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Next steps: Procurement path & PR guidance (Coupa/Ariba) - Redwood / Acme

Thanks Marissa / Alex - adding Sales Ops guidance to make PR creation and supplier onboarding as smooth as possible. Summary of what Acme procurement will need and suggested defaults from Redwood: 

1) Supplier onboarding data (typical Coupa/Ariba fields):
   - Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Address: 2201 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94110
   - Tax form: W-9 (attached)
   - Primary vendor contact: billing@redwoodinference.com (Acct: Accounting Team)
   - Bank details: we can provide for ACH if requested (sensitive - will share via secure portal or DocuSign secure link).

2) PR creation / PO routing guidance:
   - Use GL code provided in the SOW/quote (we'll provide a short line-item mapping if you need it).
   - Default payment terms: Net30 (we can accommodate Net45 with approval).
   - Billing contact for invoice: billing@redwoodinference.com; invoice should reference PO number and Redwood invoice #.

3) Marketplace vs Direct PO:
   - If Acme prefers AWS Marketplace billing, we can discuss listing/terms; marketplace may add fees and can affect invoicing/reporting.
   - For enterprise deals with negotiated terms, direct PO is more straightforward.

4) Coupa/Ariba supplier ID and linking:
   - If you register vendor on your side, please provide the supplier ID so we can map to our internal systems (example: COUPA-123456).
   - If Redwood needs to register, provide procurement portal link and a contact; we will complete the vendor form and upload W-9.

5) Internal ticketing and tracking:
   - We've created an internal procurement liaison ticket to monitor onboarding: INT-TICK-7521 (Redwood Sales Ops).
   - If Acme creates a PR, please share PR or PO number and we will push the approved invoice once the PO is received.

Attachments included: Redwood_Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf (completed), Redwood_W9.pdf

Aditya Rao
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmecorp.com>

Subject: Re: Next steps: Procurement path & PR guidance (Coupa/Ariba) - Redwood / Acme

Thanks Alex / Procurement - looping in final items and next steps so everyone has a clear playbook: 

1) Action for Acme Procurement: please confirm whether you will register Redwood in Coupa/Ariba or if you need Redwood to submit the registration. If you register, please share the supplier ID (e.g., COUPA-XXXXX). If we should register, please send the supplier portal link and preferred contact.
2) Please confirm billing preference (PO vs P-card) and expected timeline to create the PR.
3) We will provide a PO-ready invoice once the PR/PO number is shared - invoice to be sent to billing@redwoodinference.com and should reference the PO.

Internal note: tracking ticket INT-TICK-7521 is open for onboarding status and will be updated when we receive supplier ID / PO. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-8921.

If helpful, I can schedule a 15-min handoff between your procurement admin and our Sales Ops to complete the onboarding form live.

Best regards,
